target: County-specific linear yield residual, with the linear trend fit using only rows available at each evaluation stage.
selection: Choose the lowest validation RMSE among the listed candidates. No holdout score, tail metric, subgroup, or explanation is used for selection.

holdout_gate.gate_a: selected holdout RMSE better than zero baseline and upper paired 95% CI of model-minus-baseline RMSE < 0
holdout_gate.gate_b1: full versus same-model metadata-only contrast; upper paired 95% CI < 0 permits weather-specific explanation only
holdout_gate.tail: top-decile absolute-residual recovery must exceed 0.10 chance precision
